title: Liquid d1-3B GGUF on llama.cpp (2.9 GB)
slug_note: llama-server serves d1 on /v1/systemone; 8 ms per decision on an RTX 4090 (card).

variation.quant_detail: Q8_0, 2.87 GB (+ vision projector 0.58-0.86 GB); Q4_K_M 1.67 GB
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of LiquidAI/d1-3B-GGUF resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-27 test

engine.config: llama-server, /v1/systemone (decision support merged in llama.cpp PR #30110, 2026-10-07)

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): 4.8 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) at the build default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens)). Earlier estimate: Estimate: 2.87 GB weights + projector + runtime.

steps.text: Install llama.cpp (see Step 0 in Quick start); use a build from 2026-10-07 or later for d1 support.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (622-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler, long prompt (4649-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; write an LRU cache module with tests (37-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; write a 400-word essay (29-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; time to first streamed token on a cold 4649-token prompt
drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) at the build default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens)

caveats: Decision model: it answers typed questions with probabilities on /v1/systemone; it does not chat, so OpenCode and chat UIs cannot use it.
Speed figures are Liquid's own table (RTX 4090 8 ms, M5 Pro 30 ms per decision).
License is Liquid's LFM Open License, not Apache-2.0; check it for commercial use.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): `llama-server -hf LiquidAI/d1-3B-GGUF:Q8_0` — llama.cpp build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772); server ready 10 s after start with the OS file cache dropped; the functional check passed; MemAvailable dropped 4.8 GiB (weights + KV at llama.cpp's default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens on this build)).
